contentText: Dark comedy "One Battle After Another" and "Hamnet," a story about ⁠William Shakespeare's grief over the death of his son, claimed the top prizes on January 11, 2026 at the Golden Globes. The ceremony is one of the first major ones in Hollywood's annual awards season, a season that is expected to be shaped by a battle between the two films. FRANCE 24's Emma Jones tells us more about what to know from the night.
